versions.changelog:
Initial release of the customer-journey-map skill.

- Generates professional SVG, PNG, and PDF journey maps from structured YAML or legacy touchpoint table input.
- Supports both stage-based and touchpoint-based journey modeling for customer, employee, or service flows.
- Consulting-style, stage-row layout visualizes stages, touchpoints, thoughts, emotions, pain points, and opportunities.
- Output is always clean, minimal, and print-ready in McKinsey/Bain/BCG style.
- Includes Playwright-powered export for high-quality images and PDFs with full Chinese font support.
- Extensible data model and rendering pipeline enable mapping of any multi-stage experience.
